description: List the user's own profiles (their projects). Returns metadata only for each profile: its projectId, its name, its public @handle, its privacy status (private, shared, network, public, or org), and whether it is the one THIS connection reads by default. Use it when the user asks how many profiles they have, what their profiles are called, or which profile you are connected to - and whenever another tool needs a projectId to target a specific profile, because each entry carries its projectId. Do NOT use it to read the user's context, to learn about them, or to set them up with UseMyContext - the profile tool does all three. No file content, no facts, no compiled context. Read-only; nothing is written, so it is safe to call.
name: list_profiles

activeProjectId.description: The projectId this connection reads by default (matches the active profile).

active.description: True for the ONE profile this connection reads by default.

handle.description: The profile's public @handle (no leading @); null if it has none.

privacy.description: A short human-readable explanation of who can read this profile.

visibility.description: The profile's privacy status. Report it as-is.

title: List your profiles
